  • Purpose: To provide guideline instruction for monitoring adverse drug reaction event and ensure its proper reporting.
  • B. Scope : Hospital wide
  • Protocol:

In case of any drug reaction / adverse reaction actions taken are as follows:

  • The person noticing the reaction i.e. doctor /nurses immediately informs the concerned doctor & nursing station and clinical management is initiated then & there. The Nurse informs in charge pharmacy & the Nursing Incharge.
  • The ADR form is filled up by the concerned nurse or doctor
  • Drug responsible for adverse reaction is identified.
  • Information regarding any such similar reactions anywhere in the hospital is gathered and documented and forwarded to the Administrator.
  • All such events are monitored and evaluated and appropriate action taken depending on the nature of the adverse reaction
  • Such action may take the form of observation or in extreme cases withdrawal of the drug throughout the hospital
  • Drug causing adverse reaction is closely monitored.
